description: Free PDF editor and reader for editing, converting, annotating, compressing, merging, splitting, organizing, and protecting PDF files.
notes: Review status: the official JOPDF 2.4.0 release announcement is dated October 23, 2026, and the official Download Center links the Windows download to this CDN installer.

The publisher's installation guide instructs users to open the downloaded file and select Install Now. The current download is an online setup executable; its installer engine, payload layout, supported silent switches, custom installation-directory behavior, and uninstall cleanup have not been verified.

The publisher does not provide a verified SHA-256 for the current 2.4.0 download. A third-party fingerprint found during research belongs to an older July 2026 sample, so it is intentionally not reused.

The official download URL is a stable latest-version endpoint rather than a version-pinned asset. The manifest only stages the official setup file; it deliberately does not execute the installer or declare a shim or shortcut.
Keep this manifest in under review kirobucket until the current installer is inspected, its checksum is established, and a Scoop-safe installation or verified payload-extraction method is confirmed.
